summary: The host_pinned strategy runs each host through the whole play without interruption, limiting active hosts to the fork count and starting new hosts as slots free up.
questions: How do I run a play to completion per host before starting others?

answer_card.title: host_pinned strategy
answer_card.answer_md: `strategy: host_pinned` is like `free`, but a host only starts if it can finish the play without interruption; active hosts ≤ forks, and a finished host frees a slot for the next.
